answer: Offers are valid for 7 days or 300 additional miles, whichever comes first, so you could drive up to 300 more miles if the 7 days hadn't run out first. An offer from December 2025 would be well past its 7-day window by now, so it has expired. You can request a new offer at any time, and the new amount will reflect current market prices and may be higher or lower.
